name: Build Snapshot

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-snapshot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build snapshot
        env:
          DAYTONA_SNAPSHOT_NAME: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Ensure SANDBOX_ITERATE_REPO_REF is a 40-char commit SHA
          if [[ ${#GITHUB_SHA} -ne 40 ]]; then
            echo "Error: GITHUB_SHA must be a 40-char commit SHA"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Build snapshot with commit hash
          ./scripts/build-snapshot.sh --repo-ref $GITHUB_SHA --output-name iterate-sandbox-$GITHUB_SHA

      - name: Export snapshot name
        run: echo "::set-output name=snapshot_name::iterate-sandbox-${{ github.sha }}"

  deploy:
    needs: build-snapshot
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Use snapshot from previous job
        run: echo "Snapshot name: ${{ needs.build-snapshot.outputs.snapshot_name }}"
        env:
          DAYTONA_SNAPSHOT_NAME: ${{ needs.build-snapshot.outputs.snapshot_name }}
